name: acp-find-mcp
description: MCP server for searching the Virtuals Protocol ACP marketplace. Exposes acp_find, acp_compose_stack, acp_agent_reputation, acp_today, acp_browse_agent, acp_categories, and acp_health tools backed by the public api.acp-metabot.dev gateway. Works in Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, Codex, Continue, Claude Code, and Claude Desktop.
author: Oliver Pringle
